profile.name: Arianit Sylafeta
profile.tagline: I cofounded Salespeak, helping SMBs reach and qualify leads using Voice AI. I design and ship AI-native products from idea to production.

aboutSections.title: Summary
aboutSections.body: Founder focused on AI-native applications and agentic experiences, with a strong product mindset and execution speed.

aboutSections.title: Education
aboutSections.body: MSc Quantitative Finance with Data Science at Birkbeck, University of London, after a BAASc in Web and Mobile Computing.

aboutSections.title: Work Experience
aboutSections.body: Co-Founder at Salespeak (2024-present), previously Quantitative Analyst at Quantera and ML Intern at Solaborate.

aboutSections.title: Likes & Interests
aboutSections.body: Outside work, I spend time on chess, Brazilian jiu-jitsu, and exploring how Conversational + GUI agents reshape software.
